caption:
Day 6 brings 59.2 km up the Guanacaste surf coast, passing San Juanillo, Marbella, Playa Negra and Avellanas. We finish at the south end of Tamarindo Bay.

Day 7 is a 23.8 km ride from Tamarindo to the fishing village of Brasilito. We leave the bikes for a walk to Playa Conchal, where the shoreline is made of crushed shells.

We sleep 2 nights at Hotel Capitán Suizo. The ocean is a few steps from the door.

The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
